summary: Inkstone v2 gives the full board a crafted celadon, painted wood and ink treatment with expressive tile portraits and articulated purple clasps. Painted Ceramic v1 is preserved.
changes: 23 rebuilt tile designs, 16 registered facial poses, seven joined clasp parts, painted woven playing surface and lacquer Play Free button.
Quiet staggered portrait blinks and anchored moving cast shadows over a stationary surface. Attached contact shadows stay with their pieces.
Distinct selection, rejection, matching, release and cascade feedback. The larger result treatment only runs on the original no-moves outcome.
Drier material sound mix using the original recordings; source music and result sound retained.
verified: Original, Painted Ceramic v1 and Inkstone v2 have identical opening and five recorded state snapshots, including every hidden tile and lock. Counts are 75, 69, 66, 60 and 54; locks are 4, 3, 3, 3 and 2.
Converted/v1/v2 global random-call counts remain 2468 at recording start and 4908 at end.
Locked and vertical rejection, accepted nonmatching slide, gravity, source terminal state, normal asynchronous startup and deliberately missing asset fallback checked with actual input.
Real portrait textures change; seven-part clasp joints remain joined with fixed endpoints. Cast shadows change actual exposed board pixels while the background remains fixed.
Reduced-motion idle screenshots are identical; portrait and shadow clocks resume without catching up.
390px and 320px phone layouts, landscape, sound and motion buttons checked. Ordinary desktop Chromium software-WebGL play measured about 59fps; this is not a physical phone benchmark.
Actual runtime audio recorded; mixer has no missing cues or errors, and the sound reel has zero clipping samples.
limitations: Human listening and physical-device performance are not verified.
Small portrait expressions occupy only a few pixels at 320px. Purple chain centers are quieter than the bright prior edition.

The references supplied painted color/material discipline and tactile tabletop hierarchy; this is not a claim of feature-film or AAA production equivalence. Reference images do not prove animation or audio quality.

comparison.method: Separate authentic playthroughs, matched 390x694 framing, identical verified pointer gestures, normal speed. Inkstone v2 soundtrack only.
comparison.secondary: Painted Ceramic v1 versus Inkstone v2

source_fidelity.preserved: Gameplay, board, symbols, functional color families, hit areas, horizontal movement, gravity, unlock and no-moves result rules. No scores or wins invented.
source_fidelity.preexisting_conversion_difference: Original Luna auto-opens the store after its no-moves delay. The prior converted playable omits that automatic navigation; v2 preserves the converted behavior.
